context: Cheapest correct fix: add 'dsn' to the shared secret-key source (redacts the whole value, matching how connection_string is treated today). Value-preserving userinfo-stripping is optional polish, not required.
description: Found 2026-07-31 by sentinel sweep. 'dsn' is an accepted databend config field (benchbox/platforms/databend/adapter.py:124, listed in its exported field set at :217) and its value is a URL that embeds the password in userinfo (adapter.py:247-251). sanitize_platform_options passes the whole value through verbatim - driven proof: sanitize_platform_options({'dsn':'databend://joe:PW@host:8000/db'}) returns the password in clear - so the internal result bundle (platform_raw_config, runtime_metadata.py:105) carries it. The PUBLIC path happens to catch it today only via anonymization's value-shape heuristic _looks_like_connection_string (anonymization.py:404), i.e. by accident of a second layer, not by the key list. Fix on the internal path: treat 'dsn' as secret-bearing (redact the value, or strip userinfo credentials specifically). Note platform_options already has a 'connection_string' part; 'dsn' is the same class of key under another name.

preserves.behavior: Non-credential keys keep exporting real values
Public-path connection-string value-shape redaction keeps working
